messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Tell your healthcare professional if you are breastfeeding or plan to breastfeed. You and your healthcare provider should decide if you will take this medicine or breastfeed. You should not take atorvastatin if you breastfeed. Talk to your healthcare provider about the best way to feed your baby if you take LIPITOR.
Triplet: ["atorvastatin", "requires decision with", "healthcare provider"]

The relation 'requires decision with' in the triplet is defined as 'A decision regarding the use of the subject drug or the feeding method should be made jointly with a healthcare provider.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
B. 'has administration instruction': The subject drug should be taken or used in the manner specified by the object entity (for example with food or at a fixed time).
C. 'used in combination with': The subject drug is used together with the other treatment or lifestyle measure specified by the object entity.
D. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
